title: pogonospermum australe
intro: Pogonospermum australe, commonly known as the Australian button bush, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pogonospermum australe include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant are primarily limonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is necessary to fully understand its effects.
